statement: The United States will publicly confirm a resumption of military strikes on targets inside Iranian territory, reported by at least two of Reuters, the Associated Press and the BBC, between 2026-07-28 and 2026-08-26.
resolution: Resolved on 2026-08-26 by searching the Reuters, Associated Press and BBC archives: hit if at least two of the three report a US-acknowledged strike on Iranian territory dated in the window, miss otherwise.

statement: Brent crude front-month futures will trade above 100.00 dollars per barrel at some point between 2026-07-28 and 2026-08-31.
resolution: ICE Brent front-month intraday high exceeds 100.00 dollars on any session in the window per published exchange data. Reference: 90.14 on the packet date.

statement: The German federal prosecutor will publicly classify the Berlin Pride vehicle attack as a terrorist offence rather than solely a hate crime, on or before 2026-08-14.
resolution: Resolved by a statement on the Generalbundesanwalt website, or reporting by two of Deutsche Presse-Agentur, Deutsche Welle and Reuters dated on or before 2026-08-14.

statement: The German federal cabinet will approve a draft bill tightening extremism or weapons law that explicitly references the Berlin Pride attack, on or before 2026-10-31.
resolution: Resolved by the Bundesregierung cabinet decisions page listing such a Gesetzentwurf on or before 2026-10-31, with the attack named in the accompanying release.

statement: At least three separately published national voting-intention polls will place Reform UK ahead of Labour, each with fieldwork ending between 2026-07-28 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Counted from the pollsters' own published tables for that fieldwork window. Three distinct polling companies required; repeat waves by one company count once.

statement: Benjamin Netanyahu and Volodymyr Zelenskyy will both be reported as having met Donald Trump in person on United States soil between 2026-07-27 and 2026-08-10.
resolution: Resolved by White House schedules or pool reports, or by two wire services, showing both leaders in a face-to-face meeting with Trump in the window.

statement: The United States Senate will confirm Jay Clayton to the intelligence post for which he was nominated, on or before 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved by the roll-call record on congress.gov showing a completed confirmation vote in the affirmative on or before 2026-09-30.

statement: An official United States Department of Defense or service publication will report more than 900 US service members injured in the Iran conflict since February 2026, published on or before 2026-10-31.
resolution: Resolved by a figure exceeding 900 appearing in a DoD, CENTCOM or service public-affairs release or congressional testimony transcript dated on or before 2026-10-31.

statement: The Israeli cabinet will publicly approve an expansion of ground operations in Gaza beyond the limited force approved in July 2026, on or before 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved by an Israeli Prime Minister's Office statement or two wire services reporting a cabinet decision expanding the approved force, dated on or before 2026-09-30.

statement: The European Forest Fire Information System will record more than 400000 hectares burned in Spain for calendar year 2026, as published on or before 2026-11-30.
resolution: Resolved by the EFFIS annual burnt-area statistics for Spain, read from the EFFIS portal on 2026-11-30. Hit if the cumulative figure exceeds 400000 hectares.
